title.zh: 规范政府官员与雇员在菲律宾境内公务出差时费用支付的法案
title.en: An Act to Regulate Payment of Expenses of Government Officers and Employees When on Official Travel Within the Philippines.
title.orig: An Act to Regulate Payment of Expenses of Government Officers and Employees When on Official Travel Within the Philippines.

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1964/ra_3847_1964.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
When an officer or employee is required to travel on official business outside of his permanent official station, he shall be entitled to per diems to cover his board and lodging which shall be fixed on the basis of salary in the rules and regulations to be issued pursuant to Section four of this Act: Provided, That such per diems shall not be below the minimum nor above the maximum as fixed herein:
Minimum
Maximum
Manila, Bacolod, Iloilo, Davao,
Cebu and Baguio
P14.00
P20.00
Other chartered cities
12.00
16.00 Places other than cities
10.00
14.00 In addition, he shall be entitled to transportation in going to and coming back from his destination and to a daily allowance while in the field at the rate of five pesos a day in chartered cities and three pesos in all other places to cover his incidental transportation and other expenses.

Before starting on a trip, the officer or employee shall prepare a detailed itinerary of travel which shall be submitted to the chief of the office or agency concerned for approval. Based on such approved itinerary, the officer or employee shall be paid in advance of the trip the corresponding per diems, transportation and allowances as provided above: Provided, That should there be any deviation in his itinerary or his travel cancelled or cut short, his per diems and allowances shall be adjusted and he shall refund or be paid the difference as the case may be.
No travel lasting more than thirty days shall be allowed unless approved by the Department concerned.
The Auditor General shall promulgate the necessary rules and regulations to implement this Act.

Such provisions of Chapter four of the Administrative Code, Sub-sections 7-1(17), (18) and (19) of Commonwealth Act Numbered Two hundred forty-six, and all other laws or part of laws or executive orders as are inconsistent with this Act are hereby repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
